policy.title: Conservative negative-quirk treatment priorities
policy.disclaimer: Priorities are editorial guidance, not values supplied by the game. They favor preventing forced interactions and permanent loot loss; party composition and campaign resources can change the best choice.

reasons: May force interactions with Treasure curios.
Loot taken during the forced interaction is not retained by the party.
notes: Treat early before the quirk becomes locked when campaign resources allow.

reasons: May force interactions with Reflective curios.
Loot taken during the forced interaction is not retained by the party.
May force interactions with any category of curio.
notes: The actual consequence depends on the curio encountered.
